#!/bin/bash
# Generate verification report for all non-revoked SSH host certificates.
set -u
CADIR=/app/ssh-ca
INVENTORY=/app/inventory.txt
REPORT="$CADIR/verification.txt"
CA_FP=$(ssh-keygen -lf "$CADIR/ca.pub" | awk '{print $2}')

is_revoked() {
    ssh-keygen -Qf "$CADIR/revoked.krl" "$1" 2>/dev/null | grep -q REVOKED
}

{
    echo "SSH Host Certificate Verification Report"
    echo "Generated: $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')"
    echo "CA fingerprint: $CA_FP"
    echo ""
    while IFS=, read -r name fqdn ip ktype; do
        case "$name" in ''|'#'*) continue;; esac
        cert="$CADIR/${name}_host_key-cert.pub"
        if is_revoked "$cert"; then
            continue
        fi
        info=$(ssh-keygen -Lf "$cert")
        identity=$(echo "$info" | sed -n 's/.*Key ID: "\(.*\)"/\1/p')
        sig_fp=$(echo "$info" | sed -n 's/.*Signing CA: [^ ]* \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p')
        valid_from=$(echo "$info" | sed -n 's/.*Valid: from \([^ ]*\) to.*/\1/p')
        valid_to=$(echo "$info" | sed -n 's/.*Valid: from [^ ]* to \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p')
        principals=$(echo "$info" | awk '/Principals:/{f=1;next} /Critical Options:/{f=0} f && NF{printf "%s%s", (c++?", ":""), $1}')
        if [ "$sig_fp" = "$CA_FP" ]; then
            sig_status="VALID (matches CA fingerprint $CA_FP)"
        else
            sig_status="INVALID (got $sig_fp, expected $CA_FP)"
        fi
        echo "Server: $name"
        echo "  Identity: $identity"
        echo "  Principals: $principals"
        echo "  Valid from: ${valid_from:0:10} to ${valid_to:0:10}"
        echo "  CA signature: $sig_status"
        echo ""
    done < "$INVENTORY"
} > "$REPORT"
echo "Report written to $REPORT"
EOF
chmod +x /app/ssh-ca/generate_report.sh
for n in app1 app2 db1 db2 monitor; do echo "== $n =="; ssh-keygen -Lf /app/ssh-ca/${n}_host_key-cert.pub | grep -E 'Type:|Key ID:|Serial:'; done
